Data: 09/08/2018' but prediction wrote 2018-08-09, implying DD/MM swap when MM<=12 is ambiguous"},{"filename":"074.jpg","field":"total_amount","symptom":"amount_incorrect","evidence":"predicted 702.00; preprocessed+upscale OCR in window shows 'Total incl. of GST 102.00' and 'Subtotal : 102.00' and 'Payment : 102.00' with one noisy 'Total Amt Rounded ...702.00'; agent algorithm took LAST tier-4 match instead of consensus/first"},{"filename":"077.jpg","field":"total_amount","symptom":"amount_incorrect","evidence":"predicted 23.26; receipt image shows large 'TOTAL: 23.25' as final rounded total and 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' above; agent likely picked Inclusive line instead of final TOTAL line; priority tiers do not distinguish rounded final vs inclusive-of-GST"},{"filename":"078.jpg","field":"total_amount","symptom":"amount_missing","evidence":"predicted empty string; OCR 'Grand Total' line had no number on same line and next line parse failed; two-line fallback did not recover 92.80 which is on the preceding 'Total:' line not following line"}],"root_causes":[{"id":"rc_date_ambiguity","description":"Date parser cannot disambiguate DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY when both components are <=12; defaults inconsistently, producing month/day swap for receipts like 034 (09/08/2018 -> 2018-08-09 instead of 2018-09-08). No locale/region heuristic or multi-pattern voting."},{"id":"rc_tier_tiebreak","description":"Within a priority tier, selection rule (last match) is brittle: for 074 a noisy 'Total Amt Rounded 702.00' line beats the correct 'Total incl. of GST 102.00'; no consensus/majority voting across OCR passes or across repeated total-like lines."},{"id":"rc_rounded_vs_inclusive","description":"Priority ordering does not place 'rounded total' / final 'TOTAL:' line above 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' when both appear; 077 shows final rounded TOTAL 23.25 but Inclusive 23.26 was taken. Need an explicit 'ROUNDED TOTAL' / standalone 'TOTAL:' tier above generic Inclusive line."},{"id":"rc_fallback_direction","description":"Two-line fallback only looks at the NEXT non-empty line when keyword line lacks a number. For 078 the amount for 'Grand Total' appeared on a different line (likely right-column alignment lost by OCR); no backward scan or wider window; also no fallback to another tier/OCR pass."},{"id":"rc_null_vs_empty","description":"Prediction wrote '' (empty string) for 078 total instead of null. Pipeline conflates failure with empty-string output, violating 'null on failure' rule and may break downstream equality checks."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction rules do not describe disambiguation strategy for ambiguous DD/MM vs MM/DD; DATE_PATTERNS lists DD-MM-YYYY first with no justification or heuristic (e.g., prefer DD/MM for Malaysian/receipt corpus, or require day>12 to confirm, or cross-check with other date instances on the same receipt)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Total extraction section specifies 'first matching line' in one place and comment in code says 'or last-match depending on receipt convention — test on sample' — guidance is contradictory and not operationalized. No rule for consensus across OCR passes or for choosing among multiple same-tier candidates."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Priority tiers omit explicit higher-priority slots for 'ROUNDED TOTAL', 'TOTAL ROUNDED', 'TOTAL AFTER ROUNDING', and standalone final 'TOTAL:' lines; these are the authoritative final totals on many receipts and should outrank 'TOTAL (INCLUSIVE OF GST)'."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Exclusion list missing 'EXCLUDING' / 'EXCL.' / 'EXCL GST' and 'AMT EXCL', 'AMOUNT EXCL', 'SERV. CHARGE', 'SERVICE CHARGE', 'ROUNDING ADJ', 'ADJUSTMENT' which can be mistakenly matched or add noise."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"NUM_RE allows 1-digit decimals which yields false precision (e.g., 88.1 formatted as 88.10 while a correct 88.17 exists in another pass). Guidance should recommend requiring exactly 2 decimal digits for monetary totals and only fall back to looser pattern if nothing found."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Multi-pass OCR section is present but not integrated with field extraction: no instruction to run extraction on each pass and vote / prefer higher-precision agreement; the batch pipeline uses only PSM 6 then multi_pass fallback as raw string concat, which actually hurts tier selection by duplicating candidates."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Two-line fallback only looks forward one line; no guidance for right-column amounts, backward look, or using image_to_data with bounding boxes to associate keyword line with the rightmost number on the same horizontal band."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Preprocessing guidance does not mandate upscaling for small/low-DPI receipts; evidence shows 2x upscale materially improves digit accuracy (e.g., 074 102.00 recovered, 064 88.17 recovered). Skill mentions upscaling only conditionally."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Null-handling rule exists in prose ('set to None, not empty string') but no code pattern enforces it when writing to pandas/openpyxl; evidence shows '' leaked into Excel for 078."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"No explicit guidance that string-typed numeric fields written via pandas can be coerced to float or empty string; needs explicit recipe: use dtype=object, write None (not NaN/empty), and verify via load_workbook data_only read that cells are either str or empty (None), especially for amounts that must retain trailing zeros."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"Missing checklist item: verify sheet name exactly matches required ('results'), only one sheet exists, column order and header casing match spec; current xlsx skill emphasizes formulas but not strict schema conformance for data-dump tasks."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Replace contradictory selection guidance with a single operational rule: 'Within a tier, collect ALL candidates across all OCR passes (default, autocontrast, 2x-upscale+autocontrast, PSM 6/4/11). Pick the value that (a) appears most often, (b) breaks ties by highest priority tier, (c) then by exact 2-decimal match, (d) then by latest occurrence.' Include pseudocode."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand PRIORITY_TIERS and document them in order: 1) GRAND TOTAL; 2) TOTAL ROUNDED / ROUNDED TOTAL / TOTAL AFTER ROUNDING / TOTAL AMT ROUNDED; 3) TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM; 4) TOTAL AMOUNT; 5) TOTAL (INCLUSIVE OF GST) / TOTAL INCL / NETT TOTAL / NET TOTAL / TOTAL DUE / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE; 6) standalone 'TOTAL' / 'AMOUNT'. Explicitly place rounded-final above inclusive-of-GST."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand EXCLUSIONS to include: EXCLUDING, EXCL., EXCL GST, AMT EXCL, AMOUNT EXCL, SERV. CHARGE, SERVICE CHARGE, ROUNDING ADJ, ADJUSTMENT, SAVINGS, POINTS, LOYALTY, CARD, VISA, MASTERCARD, CASH TENDER, TOTAL ITEMS, TOTAL QTY, ITEM COUNT, TOTAL SAVINGS. Note that an exclusion match on the line must veto a tier match on the same line."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Change NUM_RE guidance to prefer exactly 2 decimal digits for monetary totals: '\\\\d{1,3}(?:,\\\\d{3})+\\\\.\\\\d{2}|\\\\d+\\\\.\\\\d{2}'. Only if no tier produces a 2-decimal match should a 1-decimal or integer fallback be tried, and such fallback values must still be formatted with .2f but logged as low-confidence."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Mandate multi-pass OCR as the default pipeline for receipts: run pytesseract on {raw, grayscale+autocontrast, 2x-upscale+grayscale+autocontrast} with PSM {6,4,11}, then run extract_total/extract_date on EACH output separately and vote. Do not concatenate texts; concatenation inflates duplicate candidates and biases 'last-match'."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add date disambiguation rule: parse date with ALL plausible patterns (DD/MM/YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY/MM/DD, DD MMM YYYY). Prefer parse where day>12 to lock orientation. For receipts where multiple date strings exist, require majority agreement across OCR passes. For ambiguous DD/MM where both <=12, default to DD/MM/YYYY (Malaysian receipt convention observed in dataset) and note this assumption explicitly."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Improve two-line fallback: when keyword line lacks a 2-decimal number, scan up to N=2 following non-empty lines AND the preceding line (for right-column layouts where the amount is on the same visual row but OCR split it). Also attempt pytesseract.image_to_data to recover the rightmost token on the same y-band as the keyword."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Codify null handling: wrap per-image extraction in try/except; on exception OR when no candidate passes rules, assign Python None. Never substitute '', 'None', 'nan'. Add explicit unit-level check at end of batch: assert all total_amount values are either None or re.fullmatch(r'\\\\d+\\\\.\\\\d{2}', v)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'confidence and fallback ladder' section documenting the exact order of attempts (preprocessing variant × PSM × selection rule) and when to give up vs when to escalate preprocessing (e.g., binarization, deskew). Include this as a short decision table so agents don't improvise."},{"skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a 'Strict schema data dump' recipe: use openpyxl directly (not pandas) to write header row then rows with explicit cell.value = None for missing fields; set cell.number_format = '@' for the total_amount column to force text storage; verify sheet.title == required name; ensure wb.sheetnames has exactly one entry."},{"skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a verification helper snippet that reloads the written xlsx with data_only=True and asserts: single sheet with required name, header matches exactly, every data cell is either None or a str matching the required pattern, rows sorted by filename ascending (string sort)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'common pitfalls' list with concrete examples drawn from receipt OCR: picking SUBTOTAL as TOTAL due to missing exclusion of 'EXCLUDING'; picking inclusive-of-GST line over final rounded total; truncating .17 to .1; swapping day/month on ambiguous dates; emitting empty string instead of None. Each pitfall should link to the specific rule that prevents it."}],"confidence":0.78}
